title: Golden Signals — API
description: Traffic/error/latency/saturation for openlex-api. Latency has no data source yet (see the panel note) — request-duration histogram instrumentation is a later phase.

options.content: **Traffic, error-rate, and p50/p95/p99 latency panels are pending Phase 2 backend instrumentation.** openlex-api's `/metrics` endpoint today only exports `openlex_query_requests_total` and `openlex_query_quota_exceeded_total` (both Counters labeled `tier`, see `apps/api/src/openlex_api/quota.py`) — there is no per-route HTTP request counter, no error-status breakdown, and no request-duration histogram (`prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator` or equivalent was never added). Tier/quota traffic is visible on the separate **Tier & Quota** dashboard. Only CPU/memory saturation (below) can be shown for openlex-api today from cAdvisor data.
